QuestInfo.name: Pause the Past, Save the Future
QuestInfo.0: #p2400005# and #p2400006# were deeply saddened by the loss of #p2400008#, but the fourth Goddess Teardrop was still out there. #p2400007#'s dowsing sent them to #m327000000#...\r\n\r\nExcept, they ended up somewhere else! And #p2470018# was there...
QuestInfo.1: The duo met #p2470000# and #p2470001# during their attempts to escape, and almost immediately knew that they had found the real Goddess Teardrops. \r\n\r\nWith their help, #p2400005# and #p2400006# escaped the past and made it to #m327000000#. They went to thank #b#p2470000##k and #b#p2470001##k for their help.
QuestInfo.2: #p2470000# and #p2470001# told them about the king of #m327000000#, who asked the Goddess to stop time so that his land might survive a great catastrophe. The twins had helped the king in the Goddess's stead, and asked that #p2400005# and #p2400006# continue their work so that it was not in vain.

1.0: Time is frozen in this Ludibrium. The Goddess stopped this town's past and future so that the people might live, but they will forever be children, and the clock will never move again.
1.1: But the #bLudibrium in Mirror World was not so fortunate#k. As time moves forward, the chance for pieces of time itself to collide with one another becomes greater.
1.2: We used what power we had to stop time there, but our meager powers will fail if we go with you.
1.3: You are Transcendents. Could you #bstop time in Ludibrium#k? We will help you as much as we can.

yes.0: We'll let you know when we're ready.
